description: PLAN DE GÊNE SONOREDE L'AÉROPORT D'ORLY is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by DIRECTION DEPARTEMENTALE DE L'ESSONNE. It is a plan that delimits areas in which residents can benefit from aid for the soundproofing of their homes. This aid can only be granted under certain conditions. Only the 12 main airports have a GSP. Coverage: DIRECTION DEPARTEMENTALE DE L'ESSONNE. The portal shows the English title as "SOUNDBITE PLAN OF THE AIRPORT OF ORLY" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is DIRECTION DEPARTEMENTALE DE L'ESSONNE. The listing shows 2020-01-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
